summary: MSVC-style scalar deleting destructor shape on a __thiscall object. Calls the routine named CConstructor(this) to tear down or reset the object, then, if the flag byte a2 has bit 0 set, calls FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object memory. Always returns this.

local_names.a2: flag byte; bit 0 (a2 & 1) controls whether the object memory is freed

operations.description: Call CConstructor(this) to run the object's named teardown/reset routine on this.
Guard: when (a2 & 1) != 0, proceed to free the object memory.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) to release the object memory when the flag bit is set.

unresolved: The named callee is CConstructor even though the surrounding control flow is the classic conditional-free (scalar deleting) destructor pattern; the callee's true role depends on its own implementation.
Object type behind this is unknown; FreeWrapper_7bcf is treated as the memory-release path, but its allocator provenance is outside this function.
